title: Data Entry Clerk
description:
Data Entry Clerk (Remote - Philippines)



Join Australia's Leading Running Retailer



At RunDNA, we're passionate about helping runners achieve their goals. From first-time runners to elite athletes, we provide expert advice, premium products, and exceptional service that helps people move better and run stronger.



We're looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Data Entry Clerk to join our team and play a vital role in ensuring our product information, inventory systems, invoice management and online store remain accurate, up to date and ready for customers.



This is a fully remote position based in the Philippines, working closely with our Australian warehouse, product, admin and customer service teams.



Why You'll Love This Role



Every product that appears on our website starts with you.



You'll be responsible for creating and maintaining product information that powers our inventory systems and online store. Your work directly impacts customer experience, inventory accuracy and the successful launch of new products from leading brands including ASICS, Nike, Brooks, Adidas, New Balance and Mizuno.



If you enjoy working with systems, solving problems, improving processes and ensuring everything is accurate and organised, this role is for you.



What You'll Be Doing



 - Using information provided by our suppliers; create and maintain product data information within our inventory and eCommerce systems

 - Upload new products, descriptions, images and technical specifications to the RunDNA website

 - Prepare products for launch on the RunDNA website

 - Monitor product availability and ensure timely activation of new ranges

 - Maintain inventory spreadsheets and product records

 - Assist with identifying and resolving inventory and system discrepancies

 - Support reporting and process improvement initiatives

 - Work closely with the Warehouse, Product and Customer Service teams

 - Help ensure our systems remain accurate, efficient and reliable

- Periodic fulfillment of shipped online orders that are caught part-way through their automated process 

- Accurately create and receive supplier invoices into our inventory management system

- Prepare and process supplier invoices to ensure inventory costs and stock records remain accurate

- Reconcile supplier invoices in Xero against end-of-month supplier statements and highlight missing invoices to the admin team. 



What Success Looks Like



 - Product information is entered accurately and on time

 - New products are available online before stock arrives

 - Product images and specifications are correct and complete

 - Inventory records remain organised and up to date

 - Issues are identified proactively and communicated clearly

- Invoices are created and entered with 100?curacy in a timely manner.  

 

What We're Looking For



 - Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

 - Strong organisational and time management skills

 - Confidence working with spreadsheets and business systems

 - Excellent written English communication skills

 - Ability to follow processes 

 - Strong problem-solving ability and initiative

 - Ability to work independently in a remote environment

 - Reliable internet connection and dedicated home office setup



Bonus Points For



 - Experience with inventory management systems

 - eCommerce product administration experience

 - Retail or warehouse administration experience

 - Experience using Retail Express (REX)



Our Values



At RunDNA, we believe in:



 - Delivering exceptional experiences for customers

 - Taking ownership and accountability for our work

 - Supporting each other as one team

 - Continuously learning and improving

 - Acting with integrity and professionalism

 - Looking for solutions, not excuses



We're looking for someone who shares these values and takes pride in doing great work behind the scenes that makes a real difference to our customers and team.



Salary - AUD $25,000 per annum



Ready to Apply?



If you're organised, proactive and passionate about accuracy, we'd love to hear from you.



Join RunDNA and help power the systems behind Australia's leading specialty running retailer.

etings (usually 3pm CET)

title: Faceless TikTok Editor – CapCut Keyframing for Templated Cooking Videos (3/day)
description:
I run faceless short-form cooking pages on TikTok. I need a fast, consistent editor whose core strength is KEYFRAMING in CapCut to replicate one locked style across every video, at volume.



This is a repeatable template role, not a creative freelance role. I give you the style. Your job is to reproduce it exactly, 3 videos per day, without it drifting.



THE WORK:

- 3 finished videos per day, ~35–55 seconds each, vertical 1080p.

- You work from AI-generated cooking clips I provide (light AI involvement — you're NOT the one generating, you're assembling and animating).

- Sequence the clips step-by-step to match the recipe.

- KEYFRAME everything: smooth punch-ins, zooms, pans, scale/position animation, tracked movement so every clip feels dynamic and satisfying. This is the main skill I'm hiring for.

- Add clean on-screen step + ingredient text in the locked template style.

- Sync cuts to trending/satisfying audio. Strong hook in the first 2 seconds.

- Write the caption (full recipe + hashtags).



CORE SKILLS REQUIRED:

- Expert CapCut keyframing — this is non-negotiable. If you can't animate position/scale/rotation smoothly, this isn't for you.

- Ability to replicate a reference style EXACTLY and repeat it 90+ times a month without quality drop.

- Fast, reliable daily turnaround. Consistency > creativity.

- Basic understanding of TikTok hooks, retention, and pacing.



I PROVIDE:

- The AI cooking clips / assets.

- The recipe list.

- A locked style reference + template to match.



TO APPLY:

- Start your message with the word "KEYFRAME" so I know you read this.

- Send 2 samples that clearly show your keyframing/animation work (not just cuts).

- Tell me your realistic output per day and your rate (per video or monthly).



Low-effort or copy-paste applications will be ignored.

title: Virtual Admin Assistant
description:

About the Role



We're looking for a Virtual Event Administrator to join our growing team!



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy keeping projects organized, and love bringing events to life behind the scenes, this could be the perfect role for you. You'll play a key role in coordinating events from initial inquiry through successful execution, working closely with clients, vendors, and internal tea
mbers to ensure every detail is handled with care. No two days look the same, and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

title: Full Time Closer Real Estate – $4/hr + 2% Commission
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated, results-driven Sales Closer to join our remote team. This is a performance-based role focused on helping distressed property owners recover unclaimed funds legally owed to them by counties or states after losing their homes (e.g., surplus proceeds from tax sales or foreclosures).



You will conduct cold outreach, build trust quickly, handle objections, and secure signed agreements for our company to recover these funds on their behalf. This role combines sales, detective/skip tracing work, and strong relationship-building. Top performers can earn significant income through commissions.



Key Responsibilities:

- Make 200–300 cold calls per day, 5 days a week during US Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

- Locate and contact property owners/heirs using provided leads, skip tracing techniques, and your own research when numbers don’t connect.

- Effectively communicate the value of our service and close agreements over the phone.

- Perform light investigative work to find correct contacts and verify information.

- Option to set appointments for complex cases.

- Log all activity accurately in our CRM.

- Be highly coachable and implement feedback to continuously improve closing rates and daily performance.



Compensation:

- Base pay: $4 per hour

- Commission: 2% of all fees collected (paid biweekly)

- Average case value: $20,000 – $40,000+ (some smaller, some significantly larger)

- Realistic earnings potential for consistent closers: substantial supplemental or full-time income depending on volume and close rate



Requirements (Non-Negotiable):

- 100% Native-level English speaker with ZERO accent** – must sound like a professional American closer on every call.

- Exceptional phone sales and communication skills – persuasive, empathetic, resilient, and professional.

- Proven high work ethic and self-discipline (this is a high-volume dialing role).

- Extremely coachable with a growth mindset – willing to follow scripts, training, and management direction.

- Comfortable with high daily call volume (200–300 dials) and rejection.

- Experience in skip tracing, real estate, debt collection, mortgage, insurance, or high-volume cold calling is a big plus.

- Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and a computer/headset.

- Must be available full-time during EST business hours.



What We Provide:

- Comprehensive training and ongoing coaching

- CRM system

- Dialer and call lists

- Phone numbers

- Supportive team environment focused on your success



This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who loves sales, enjoys the thrill of the hunt (both finding people and closing deals), and wants uncapped earning potential based on their effort and skill.



If you are a hungry, ethical, high-energy sales professional who can handle high volume and wants to make a real difference while earning great money, we want to hear from you.



To Apply:



Please reply with:

- Your full name and location (time zone)

- A brief voice note or video (1 minute max) introducing yourself and why you’d be great at this role

- Your relevant sales or calling experience

- Confirmation that you have zero accent and are fully available during EST hours



Only serious, qualified candidates who meet the English fluency requirement will be contacted. We move fast for the right person.



We look forward to speaking with our next top closer!

title: Squarespace Website Manager and Virtual Assistant for Music Education
description:

The Website Manager and Virtual Assistant is a detail-oriented implementation specialist responsible for turning curriculum ideas into organized, polished, functional resources and website experiences for members.



You'll work extensively in Squarespace and Google Drive, following established workflows to upload content, organize digital resources, proofread materials, and maintain a consistent experience across the website.



Success in this role comes from careful execution of and commitment to details. You'll use checklists, style guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure typography, spacing, colors, formatting, links, and organization meet a high standard of quality every time.



If you naturally notice small details, enjoy organizing information, appreciate consistency, and take pride in producing polished work, you'll thrive in this role.



A willingness to quickly learn music terminology, notation, and pedagogy is essential.



Your schedule will be flexible (between 15 - 30 hours a week). You may work whatever days and whatever hours you prefer, as long as tasks are completed early or (at the latest) by the deadline. 



Important: This job is highly demanding. However, it is imperative to me that all tea
mbers enjoy their work. Expect a positive work environment with extremely high standards. 



----------------------



RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Website Management

Upload, edit, maintain, and optimize the Squarespace website and Google Drive materials for user experience and functionality.



2. Digital Asset Formatting

Format Google Docs and Google Slides meticulously based on brand guidelines and SOPs. This includes highly detailed work such as adjusting typography, applying brand colors, aligning text, adjusting spacing, etc.

Compile Google Slides by including necessary music lesson components ("I can" statements, repertoire lyrics, detailed teacher presentation notes, etc.) according to provided pedagogy guidelines and templates.

Format, organize, and cross-reference repertoire for K-5 general music.

Transcribe music notation

Identify and report issues related to website performance, usability, and responsiveness.

Catch errors before anyone else has a chance to notice them 



4. Project Tracking 

Keep detailed, up-to-date records of ongoing projects and website uploads, updating statuses and timelines as directed.

Follow and apply existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for recurring tasks such as website uploads and document formatting.

Maintain and update the upload schedule and task sequence as outlined by leadership.



5. Executive Support:

Assist with administrative tasks such as updating and organizing existing project lists and timelines.

Communicate effectively and proactively. Keep detailed meeting notes, send reminders about upcoming deadlines, and flag potential issues as they arise.



------------------------

)

title: Technical Meta Specialist (As Needed)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION



Access Adventure Club is an Australian company on a mission to connect young people with nature, to improve the wellbeing of our next generation. We predominantly achieve this through delivering our Accessible Adventure programs for young people with disabilities.



We have been in operation for 10 years and are leaders in a uniquely positioned niche that falls between education, disability support and tourism in Australia. We currently have a team of 15 full time staff and approximately 40 casual staff. This includes 9 high performing full time staff in the Philippines. 



Our core values are:

We resonate good vibes

We are hungry to contribute the company’s purpose

We are highly organised and disciplined

We are adaptable to change

We are optimists, with can-do attitudes

Challenge is an opportunity for personal growth

ROLE DESCRIPTION



As the Technical Meta Specialist, you will be a consultant responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, delivery disruptions, tracking errors, and compliance or account health issues to ensure consistent, optimised campaign performance.



Here is an outline of the job requirements:



Role Requirements – Technical Meta Specialist (As Needed)

Highly experienced in the technical setup, management, and optimisation of Meta advertising campaigns.

Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager, Events Manager, and Meta Pixel/Conversions API.

Able to quickly diagnose and troubleshoot issues affecting campaign performance, delivery, tracking, or account health.

Confident identifying technical causes of poor ad performance and implementing effective solutions.

Experienced with audience setup, event tracking, attribution, custom conversions, and campaign optimisation.

Knowledge of Meta's advertising policies and ability to resolve account, ad, or compliance issues where possible.

Comfortable analysing campaign data to identify opportunities for improved performance and return on ad spend (ROAS).

Able to communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical tea
mbers.

Available on an as-needed basis to provide technical support, troubleshooting, and strategic advice.

Proactive, solutions-focused, and able to respond promptly when technical issues arise.

Experience working collaboratively with marketing, creative, and social media teams.

Keeps up to date with changes to Meta's advertising platform, features, and best practices.





Bonus Skills (Highly Desirable)

Experience managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube).

Strong understanding of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

Ability to troubleshoot cross-platform tracking and attribution issues between Meta and Google.

Experience improving campaign performance across multiple advertising platforms.





This role is a technical specialist rather than a general media buyer or ad/content creator. We need someone we can call in when campaigns aren't performing as expected or when technical expertise is needed to optimise results.





The Ideal Candidate will be a person who:

• Demonstrates expertise and experience in troubleshooting Meta Ads issues.

• Has a keen interest and is at the forefront of AI apps.

• Is a good English communicator both written and on live video, and can communicate technical solutions in an easy to understand non-technical manner.

• Is highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.





Other Requirements:



- Stable internet connection with a minimum standard of 20 mbps download / 5 mbps upload

- Life-long learner with a thirst for knowledge

- Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively as part of a team

title: Junior Virtual Assistant
description:
At Enlightening Motherhood, we help parents of neurodivergent children build emotional resilience and stronger family relationships through online classes, coaching, and education. We're a small, heart-centered team doing big things — and we're growing.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA who takes ownership of their work and loves bringing order to a creative, mission-driven space.

_______



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Video editing and clipping using Riverside/Capcut

• Creating social media graphics and thumbnails in Canva

• Scheduling and repurposing content across platforms

• Uploading and organizing course content in Thrivecart and Skool

• Supporting general admin and operations as the business grows



---



TOOLS WE USE

Descript · Canva · Metricool · Google Workspace · Slack · Asana · Thrivecart · Heartbeat · Flodesk · WordPress · ChatGPT · Zoom



We don't expect you to know all of them. We do expect you to figure them out.



_______________

THIS IS FOR YOU IF



? You do what you say you will do

? You message ahead of time — not after — if something comes up

? When you hit a tech problem, you search, try, and figure it out before asking for help

? You check your work before submitting it

? You catch mistakes — yours or a teammate's — and fix them or flag them kindly

? You speak up when you have a question, a struggle, or an idea

? You are honest, even when it's uncomfortable

? You are kind, even when you're correcting someone



A few things that matter to us that you won’t find in most job posts



We serve a community of parents who are already exhausted. They come to us because their neurodivergent kids deserve better tools—and so do they. That means the work we do has to be done with care. A task that gets rushed or half-finished doesn’t just create a to-do list problem, it affects real families.



Our team moves fast, thinks creatively, and sometimes needs people who can catch what falls through the cracks without being asked. If you need every detail spelled out before you can move, this won’t feel good for either of us. But if you love bringing order to a creative, mission-driven space and can think on your feet, you will thrive here.



We also use a lot of tools. Not because we love complexity, but because we’re a small team doing big things. We don’t expect you to know all of them. We do expect you to figure them out without needing us to walk you through every step.



We are not a difficult team to work with. We are supportive, we celebrate good work, and we want you to succeed. But we need someone we can trust completely, because we will not be checking on you every hour. You will have real responsibility here, and we want you to own it.

_____________________



Growth of this role



This contract begins part-time at 5–10 hours per week. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us. As the business expands and you prove yourself in this role, we anticipate this engagement increasing in both scope and hours with the potential to grow toward 20+ hours per week and beyond as you develop your expertise and we scale.



We are genuinely looking for a long-term hire. We want to invest in someone who is invested in us. If you are looking for a genuine opportunity to help build something meaningful while growing your own skills, this may be exactly what you’re looking for.



This role requires someone who enjoys bringing order to operations, taking ownership, and continuously improving how things work. If you prefer simply completing assigned tasks rather than improving how things work, this role will likely feel frustrating.



_________________



AVAILABILITY

Monday–Friday with at least 1–2 hours of overlap with US Mountain Time (MST). Full focus while working — no double-tasking.



PAY

$___/hour USD (please include your rate when you apply in the Google Form)





HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a simple reply. COMPLETE THE FULL APPLICATION HERE: 



We read every application personally and are looking for a long-term fit. If this sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.



Warmly,

Emily

Enlightening Motherhood

title: Senior Bookkeeper - Accounts, Reconciliations & Compliance Support
description:
Be part of a vibrant Australian-based construction company!



Employment Type: Independent Contractor – Full-Time VA Engagement (contractor agreement, not direct employment)

Location: Remote, Philippines-based

Working Hours: Minimum 4 hours, ideally up to 6 hours, of daily overlap with AEST/AEDT business hours

Reports To: Director

Salary: AUD $2,000–$2,600 per month, dependent on experience (approx. AUD $11.50–$15.00 per hour / AUD $460–$600 per week, based on a standard 40-hour week)

Payment Cycle: Paid weekly in AUD, one week in arrears (i.e. payment for a given week's work is made the following week)



About Us

We are a growing Australian-based construction company specialising in warehouse racking installation projects. We are seeking an experienced, reliable, and detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to support our finance, bookkeeping, and compliance functions remotely, as part of a small in-house accounts team.



About the Role

This role is ideal for someone with strong, hands-on experience in Australian bookkeeping practices, reconciliations, and compliance administration. You will take ownership of day-to-day accounts payable, bank reconciliations, WorkCover and Incolink/CoInvest administration, and general finance support – working with a high degree of autonomy.



As this is a virtual contractor role, you must be highly organised, responsive, trustworthy, and able to work independently while communicating clearly with the team.



Scope note: this role focuses on data entry, reconciliations, and compliance administration. BAS, IAS, payroll tax lodgements, and other ATO-related tax lodgements are prepared and lodged by our external accounting firm, Mode Advisory, and are not part of this role.



Reporting & Team Structure

This role reports directly to the Director. You will work closely alongside Precious, who currently manages payroll, invoicing, and accounts payable. Once this role is in place, Precious will retain responsibility for payroll, invoicing, and employee reimbursements, while general accounts payable responsibilities will transition to this role. The two positions are expected to work collaboratively as a team, coordinating on shared processes and providing cover for one another.



Key Responsibilities

•Manage day-to-day accounts payable processes, including invoice checking, approvals, coding, and payment preparation (final payment release is authorised by the Director)

•Complete regular bank reconciliations and ensure transactions are recorded accurately in Xero

•Prepare and lodge Incolink and CoInvest submissions

•Manage WorkCover administration and reconciliations

•Support payroll tax reconciliations (lodgements are prepared and lodged by our external accounting firm, Mode Advisory)

•Manage Budgetly allocations, expense tracking, and transaction coding

•Support inter-entity loan reconciliations and related account adjustments

•Maintain accurate accounts, compliance records, reports, and supporting documentation

•Liaise professionally with internal departments, suppliers, subcontractors, and our external accounting firm

•Support recurring finance deadlines, month-end processes, and general finance administration

•Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, workflow, and efficiency across accounts and bookkeeping processes

•Provide ad-hoc payroll assistance and support as required

•Work closely with the existing accounts tea
mber on shared processes and coverage



Requirements

•5+ years’ experience in a senior bookkeeping, accounts, or similar role, ideally supporting Australian businesses

•Working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping fundamentals, including GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, payroll, and superannuation concepts (this role does not lodge these, but understanding them is important for accurate coding and reconciliation)

•Required: hands-on experience with Xero, our core accounting platform

•Experience with Budgetly, Incolink, CoInvest, and WorkCover portals highly regarded

•Experience with accounts payable, bank reconciliations, payroll support, month-end processes, and financial record keeping

•Confident using spreadsheets,
, cloud-based systems, and online admin tools

•Strong written and verbal English communication skills

•High attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information

•Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to meet recurring deadlines

•Ability to communicate professionally with internal teams, suppliers, subcontractors, and our external accountants

•Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies

•Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information with professionalism and discretion

•Comfortable working within defined financial controls – this role prepares transactions and payments; final payment release is authorised by the Director

•Availability for a minimum of 4 hours, ideally up to 6 hours, of daily overlap with AEST/AEDT business hours

•Ability to work remotely as part of a small, collaborative accounts team with minimal supervision



Highly Regarded

•Experience with Incolink, CoInvest, WorkCover, and similar Australian compliance processes

•Experience with Australian construction, trades, labour hire, or project-based industries

•Experience supporting Australian accountants, CFOs, or finance teams remotely

•Prior experience in a fully remote contractor role with an Australian business



What We Offer

•A supportive, professional, and team-focused working environment, working closely alongside our existing accounts tea
mber

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist |  Long-Term Leadership Opportunity



We are looking for someone who can help us find, screen, assess, and present top remote professionals for a variety of business roles, including administrative, customer support, sales support, marketing, operations, finance, bookkeeping, technical, and specialist positions.



The right person is highly organized, sharp, proactive, and able to identify true A-player talent — not just people who look good on paper.



We are looking for someone who can eventually become a key person in our recruiting operations. If you are someone who takes ownership, improves systems, communicates clearly, and cares deeply about hiring quality, this could become a long-term leadership opportunity.



What You’ll Be Doing

* Source high-quality candidates across job boards, social media, LinkedIn, databases, referrals, and other talent channels

* Review applications, resumes, profiles, and candidate responses with strong attention to detail

* Screen applicants for experience, communication skills, reliability, professionalism, role fit, and long-term potential

* Conduct initial interviews and ask thoughtful follow-up questions

* Assess candidate quality beyond keywords and surface-level resume matching

* Write clear, concise, and useful candidate summaries and recommendations

* Maintain accurate candidate records, pipeline updates, tags, notes, and statuses

* Coordinate interviews, follow-ups, candidate updates, and next steps

* Build strong talent pipelines for current and future roles

* Identify red flags early and protect the quality of the hiring process

* Help improve recruiting workflows, templates, screening questions, scorecards, and systems

* Work with leadership to understand hiring priorities and provide useful recruiting insights



Requirements

- We are not looking for an average recruiter. We are looking for someone who operates with ownership, urgency, and strong judgment.



You must have:

* Proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, sourcing, HR, or candidate screening

* Strong ability to identify high-quality candidates beyond simply matching keywords on a resume

* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently

* Strong interview judgment and the ability to assess communication skills, professionalism, reliability, culture fit, and long-term potential

* A high level of attention to detail when reviewing resumes, applications, profiles, and candidate responses

* Ability to write clear, concise, and useful candidate summaries for leadership

* Strong organization skills and the ability to manage multiple roles, candidates, follow-ups, and deadlines at the same time

* Fast response time and strong follow-through without needing constant reminders

* Comfort working with targets, scorecards, hiring standards, and recruiting KPIs

* Experience using job boards, LinkedIn, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, ATS platforms, or similar recruiting tools

* Ability to work independently, solve problems, and improve processes instead of only waiting for instructions

* Strong sense of accountability, professionalism, and urgency

* Reliable internet connection and remote work setup

* Availability for consistent overlap with Eastern Time business hours



You Will Stand Out If You Have

* Experience recruiting remote professionals for North American companies

* Experience hiring for multiple role types, such as admin, customer support, sales support, marketing, operations, finance, bookkeeping, or technical roles

* Experience using ATS platforms

* Experience with Manatal is an asset

* Experience creating or using candidate scorecards

* Experience building talent pipelines, not just filling open roles

* Experience improving recruiting workflows, templates, interview questions, or screening systems

* Previous leadership experience or clear potential to eventually manage recruiters

* Strong business judgment and the ability to understand what a company actually needs, not just what a job description says



This Role Is Not For You If

* You only screen candidates by checking whether their resume matches the job description

* You need constant reminders to follow up

* You send generic candidate notes without real insight

* You are uncomfortable asking detailed interview questions

* You avoid accountability or move slowly

* You are not confident communicating in English

* You prefer task-based work and do not want to grow into a bigger role

* You are not interested in improving systems, processes, or recruiting quality



What Success Looks Like



In this role, success means:

* High-quality candidates are identified and moved through the process quickly

* Candidate notes and recommendations are clear, useful, and accurate

* Hiring pipelines are organized and up to date

* Strong candidates are not missed because of weak screening

* Red flags are identified early

* Communication is fast, professional, and consistent

* Recruiting workflows become cleaner, faster, and more scalable over time

* Leadership can trust your judgment and rely on your recommendations



Schedule

- This is a remote role with required overlap with Eastern Time business hours.

- Exact schedule can be discussed based on experience, availability, and fit.



Compensation

- Please include your expected hourly or monthly rate in your application.

- Compensation will depend on experience, skill level, and ability to take ownership of the role.



How To Apply

To apply, please send the following:

1. Your CV

2. The recruiting tools, job boards, or ATS platforms you have used

3. Your expected hourly or monthly rate

4. Video-intro is strongly preferred



Please start your application with the word A-PLAYER so we know you read the full post.



Applications that are generic, incomplete, or do not follow instructions will not be prioritized.

title: Expert SEO / AEO Specialist (Full time, Remote, Long-Term)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We're a performance-focused digital agency that takes SEO and organic growth seriously not as an add-on service, but as the core of what we do. We work with ambitious clients who want to win in search, and we need experts who are obsessed with making that happen.



We're not looking for generalists who dabble in SEO between other tasks. We want a specialist who wakes up thinking about algorithm updates, tests hypotheses on weekends, and gets a genuine buzz from watching a client climb from page 3 to position 1.



If that sounds like you read on.



THE ROLE



This is a senior, hands-on SEO/AEO Specialist role for someone who can own an entire search strategy not just execute tasks handed down from above. You'll work directly with clients and internal stakeholders, leading the research, strategy, execution, and reporting that drives measurable organic growth.



AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is no longer optional  it's where search is heading. You'll be expected to understand and actively optimise for AI-driven answers, featured snippets, voice search, and the rapidly evolving landscape of LLM-influenced SERPs. If you haven't heard of AEO or GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), this isn't the right role for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Strategy & Planning

 - Develop comprehensive, data-led SEO and AEO strategies tailored to each client's industry, competition, and business objectives

 - Conduct deep-dive keyword research, competitive gap analysis, and search intent mapping going beyond volume to understand what drives conversions

 - Stay ahead of Google algorithm updates, SERP feature changes, and AI-generated result behaviours (SGE, Gemini, ChatGPT citations) and adapt strategies accordingly

 - Build and present strategy documents and roadmaps that clients actually understand and get excited about



Technical SEO

 - Perform thorough technical audits covering crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, structured data (schema), and mobile performance

 - Diagnose and resolve technical issues that are preventing pages from ranking not just document them, but fix them or work directly with developers to get them fixed

 - Implement and validate schema markup for rich results: FAQs, How-Tos, Articles, Products, People, and more critical for AEO performance

 - Audit and optimise for E-E-A-T signals across the site



On-Page & Content Optimisation

 - Optimise existing content and brief new content to capture featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes, AI overviews, and other zero-click SERP features

 - Conduct content gap analysis and develop topical authority frameworks that position clients as the go-to source in their niche

 - Optimise page structure, meta data, headings, and internal linking with precision nothing sloppy, nothing template-driven

 - Guide content teams on SEO best practices: search intent alignment, NLP optimisation, conversational query targeting, and FAQ structuring for AEO



Off-Page & Authority Building

 - Develop and execute ethical, white-hat link building strategies digital PR, resource pages, broken link building, HARO/journalist outreach

 - Audit backlink profiles, disavow toxic links, and track referring domain growth over time

 - Identify and pursue unlinked brand mention opportunities



Reporting & Communication

 - Deliver clear, insightful monthly reports that tie SEO activity to business outcomes not vanity metrics, but leads, revenue, and ROI

 - Use GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio with fluency

 - Communicate proactively — flag wins, flag problems, and always show up with a solution



WHAT YOU BRING



We will ask you to prove everything on this list. Come prepared.



 - 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a strong portfolio of measurable ranking and traffic improvements across multiple industries

 - Demonstrated AEO experience: optimising for featured snippets, PAA, voice search, and AI overviews (SGE / Gemini)

 - Deep technical SEO proficiency — you can read a crawl log, interpret a Core Web Vitals report, and debug a canonical issue without hand-holding

 - Expert-level command of: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, GA4, Google Search Console, and at least one reporting/data visualisation tool (Looker Studio, Data Studio)

 - Strong understanding of schema markup and structured data implementation ideally hands-on, not just theoretical

  - A clear understanding of how LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) are surfacing content, and how to optimise for citation and inclusion in AI-generated answers

 - Solid grasp of on-page copywriting principles you don't need to be a writer, but you need to write and review briefs that make writers produce content that ranks

 - Experience working in an agency environment, managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

 - Excellent written English — your reports, audits, and strategy docs are polished and professional

 - Reliable, fast internet connection and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace



BONUS POINTS



You don't need all of these, but they'll make us pay attention:



 - Experience with international or multilingual SEO and hreflang implementation

 - WordPress, Shopify, or headless CMS technical knowledge

 - Experience optimising for Google Business Profile and local SEO

 - Familiarity with Python or Google Apps Script for SEO automation

 - Published writing, conference talks, or contributions to the SEO community (blogs,
/X, LinkedIn)

 - Experience with Programmatic SEO or content scaling strategies



WHO YOU ARE



Skills matter. But so does the kind of person you are to work with. We're looking for someone who:



 - Takes ownership. You don't wait to be told what to fix you find it, flag it, and fix it.

 - Is obsessively curious. Algorithm dropped? You're already reading the analysis on X and testing on your own sites.

 - Communicates with clarity. No corporate waffle. Say what you mean, mean what you say, and write it in plain English.

 - Is honest and accountable. Rankings go down. Traffic dips. We want someone who explains what happened and what we're doing about it — not someone who buries the bad news.

 - Loves learning. SEO in 2025 looks nothing like SEO in 2020. You've kept up — and you're ready for wherever it goes next.



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application carefully. Here's how to stand out:



 - Submit your CV with a clear summary of your SEO experience and the tools you use daily

 - Include 2–3 case studies or examples of campaigns you've led — show us the before/after, what you did, and the results

 - In the subject line of your application, write: "I actually read the job description" — this tells us you pay attention to detail

 - Optional but impressive: share a quick Loom video (under 3 minutes) walking us through a piece of SEO work you're proud of



Applications without relevant SEO experience or examples will not be considered. We're serious about finding the right person, and we know that takes time.

title: Short-Form Video Script Copyeditor (US English)
description:
WHO I AM:

I'm a certified coach, and I've recently started building my personal brand on Instagram (and TikTok) from scratch. I'm looking for someone to help me copyedit my video (reels) scripts in natural US English. I work in a very specific psychology niche - people-pleasing, boundaries, and relationship coaching.



GOAL:

I'm looking for a copyeditor, partly also a copywriter. I write all of my scripts myself. First, I use AI to fix the obvious grammar mistakes, and then I need a human copyeditor to:



1. Make the script sound natural in spoken US English.

2. Make sure the script performs well on Instagram and TikTok (mainly Instagram).



For me, "performing well" means:

- Making sure the script doesn't miss the main point and provides enough value for the viewer. If something is unclear, vague, or missing, I want you to point it out.

- But also making sure the script isn't too wordy or too abstract, and doesn't contain parts where viewers are likely to lose attention.



SCRIPTS:

My scripts are short.

- Most are under 200 words (around 160 words on average).

- If a script exceeds 350 words, I'll count it as two scripts.

- Every script follows the same structure - Hook, Juice (main content), Learning and Closing/CTA

- To help you understand my audience, I can also provide a detailed ICP (Ideal Customer Profile).



WHAT I EXPECT

When reviewing my scripts, these are the most important things to me:

1. General

The more concise, the better. If something can be said in fewer words, that's usually the better option. If an extra sentence or example doesn't add much value, I'd rather remove it.



2. Hooks

This is probably the hardest part because every niche is different. Some hooks are overused and no longer work. Others simply don't fit my niche. So, I need very honest feedback on my hooks.



3. Juice

This is the section where I need the most help. Sometimes I explain too much, and other times I leave out important information.

For example, I might describe the problem but fail to explain the consequences or why the viewer should care.

It's always a balance between keeping the script short and making sure the value and the main point are clear.



4. Learning / Closing

I usually end with a practical takeaway or a new perspective. I want to make sure the ending actually makes sense.

For example, if the takeaway isn't clear or doesn't connect well to the problem discussed earlier, I'd like you to point that out.



YOUR BACKGROUND:

I'm only looking for experienced copyeditors/copywriters who have a portfolio and examples of previous work.

If you're new to writing and editing social media scripts, then this isn't the right fit. I can usually tell from the first script reviews.



PLEASE DON'T apply if you don't have a portfolio or examples to share for short-form video scripts IG/TT.



HOW TO APPLY:

If you've read everything until the end and interested, please start your application by:

1. Sharing your portfolio or examples of your work.

2. Telling me how long you've been working as a copyeditor/copywriter.



Thanks for reading, and I look forward to hearing from you!

title: Customer Service Representative (Growth Path to CS Manager)
description:
About Us:



We are an e-commerce dropshipping company operating multiple online stores across different niches — currently mainly operating in the fashion niche, with more on the way. As we scale our business we are looking to expanding our team to match. With multiple years of experience in e-commerce, we are now starting new stores, new angles, new ideas. A new start meaning we are looking for new members to join us.



With intention to grow into many stores within the next 3-6 months, and scale our businesses to high levels, it is important we hire someone from the beginning to be along with us in our journey.



This is not a typical CS job. We are looking for someone who starts as a Customer Service Representative but is being hired with the explicit intention of growing into a Customer Service Manager — someone who will eventually own the entire CS function, hire their own team, and manage reps across multiple stores.



If you want a job where you answer
s and clock out, this is not for you. If you want to grow, take on real responsibility, and have ambition to grow in this field — read on.



This isn't a "clock in, answer
s, clock out" job. We're hiring someone we intend to work closely with, trust, and grow with.



How We Work Together:



This matters as much as the skills section below, so we're putting it first.



We do a weekly 1:1 check-in — not a formality, an actual conversation about what's working, what's not, and where we can improve in.

We give direct feedback often, including small corrections. We expect you to take it well, ask questions, and adjust — not push back or get defensive.

We're building a long-term working relationship, not just filling a ticket queue. If you prefer to be left alone with zero check-ins, this isn't the right fit.

Good CS is 50% skill, 50% how you communicate with us and with customers. We weigh both equally.





The Role:



Phase 1 — CS Representative



Handle inbound customer service
s for our fashion stores

Resolve returns, refunds, damaged items, order inquiries, and complaints, following our SOPs

Target response time: under 1-3 hours during business hours

Escalate complex cases with clear notes

Learn our products, policies, and resolution procedures thoroughly





Phase 2 — CS Manager (earned through performance, and skill, not just time with us)



Hire, train, and manage additional CS reps as we scale

Own quality control — review responses, catch gaps, improve SOPs

Update SOPs as new stores/niches are added

Report on CS metrics to leadership

Be the first point of escalation





What You Need:





At least 1 year of customer service experience, ideally e-commerce

Excellent written English — clear, professional, empathetic

Calm and steady with upset or frustrated customers

Strong attention to detail — you'll follow specific SOPs and every step matters

Reliable internet and availability during US business hours

Good with receiving direct feedback and course-correcting quickly, without taking it personally

Self-starter, but also genuinely wants regular check-ins and collaboration — not someone who wants to be handed a task and never spoken to again





Big plus:



E-commerce CS experience (returns, refunds, disputes)

Experience with Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze or similar tools (preferably Reamaze)

Prior experience training or supervising others

Familiarity with international shipping or dropshipping complaints





Compensation



We pay in tiers tied to real, defined milestones — not vague promises, and not a negotiation later. Here's the full ladder upfront:



Phase 1 — CS RepHandles tickets, follows SOPs, depending on experience - $3.00–4.50/hr



Phase 1.5 — Senior RepFaster/harder tickets, input on QA, trusted on edge cases - $5–6/hr



Phase 2 — CS ManagerHires/trains/manages reps, owns SOPs, reports directly to leadership - $7–10/hr or a defined monthly salary





Review checkpoints at 30 / 60 / 90 days. Movement between tiers is based on clear, agreed criteria at each checkpoint — not a mood or a favor. We'll tell you exactly what's needed to move up before you get there.

We're upfront: if a specific number is a dealbreaker for you today, let's talk about it before you apply, not three months in.





How to Apply:



Send all of the following. Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.





1. A short introduction — who you are. and why this role (not just any CS job) interests you.



2. Write out, in full, how you'd respond to the first response
 for this customers inquiry:



"I ordered a dress 2 weeks ago and it looks completely different from the photos. The color is way off and I want a full refund. I'm going to leave a bad review everywhere if this isn't resolved today."





3. Tell us about a time someone corrected your work or gave you feedback you initially disagreed with. What happened, and how did you handle it? (Be specific and honest — this matters more to us than a perfect answer.)



4. Your previous work experience, what you did, and why did you stop working with them?



5. In your opinion, what matters the most when working together in a team?



6. Your availability — confirm you can work US business hours, and list any blackout dates in the next 30 days.

description:
I'm a residential real estate agent in Spokane, Washington. Last year I closed 73 transactions

and about $31M in volume — top 10 in the Spokane MLS. My YouTube channel is the largest

real estate channel in the region and it's my biggest lead engine. I also run two Instagram

pages: my personal brand, and a local-news-style page called The Spokane Real.



I'm looking for one person to run my content operation. My scripts are already mostly AI generate: I have a tool that writes them, an AI research pipeline that sends topics with prewritten scripts, and subscriptions to AiM (Jason Pantana), Listing Leads (Jimmy Mackin), and Attraction by Video (Jared Chamerlain) that give me proven marketing frameworks every week.



You're not starting from a blank page — you're pulling from all of that, turning it into one real

content calendar, telling me what I'm filming, and running the operation. 



I batch-shoot all my YouTube videos for the month in one day and hand it off to a freelance editor you'll manage.

Each week I also film short-form content, including green screen segments, which you'll edit yourself and publish across two Instagram pages.



What You'll Own

• Building the content calendar from my AI tools and subscriptions, and telling me what I'm filming — with some input fro
.

• Handing off the monthly YouTube batch to a freelance editor, reviewing their cuts, and managing YouTube upload, metadata, and scheduling. You don't edit the long-form videos yourself.

• Editing all short-form content — including green screen segments — from my weekly filming session for two Instagram pages with different tones, plus small graphics/thumbnail requests.

• Posting and scheduling across YouTube and both Instagram pages.

• Writing and sending a weekly newsletter.

• Managing an ongoing blog content strategy, plus basic website updates.

• Keeping every online profile — Google Business, FastExpert, Zillow — accurate and current.

• Tracking and improving how often I show up in AI search results (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

• Bringing me content ideas within the direction I set — this is the most important part of the job.



What I Need From You

• Real short-form video editing skill, including green screen work — you can show me finished work, not just raw clips. Long-form YouTube editing isn't required.

• Strong project management — you can run five channels and an outside freelance editor at once without anything slipping.

• Comfort using and directing AI tools — you don't need to write scripts from scratch, but you need to know good output from bad.

• Working knowledge of local SEO / AI search visibility, or you learn fast.

• Basic website editing skills.

• Strong written English.

• You go get things done. If something needs fixing or a profile is out of date, you fix it — you don't wait to be told.

title: Part-Time Meta Ad Creative Planner & Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a part-time Ad Creative Planner & Video Editor to help create high-performing ad content for a growing clothing brand.



This role is for someone who understands how to plan, organize, and edit paid ad content for Instagram and
 Meta ads.



We are not just looking for someone who can make videos look cool. We need someone who can help create different ad angles, organize footage, plan weekly ad content, and edit multiple variations that can be tested for performance.



- About the Role

You will help us create ad content for:



* Instagram ads

*
 ads

* Meta ad campaigns

* Product videos

* UGC-style ads

* Lifestyle clips

* Founder videos

* Clothing brand content



We will provide the raw footage. Your job is to help plan the ad ideas, organize the footage, and edit the videos into strong ad creatives.



- Main Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:



* Helping plan weekly ad content

* Creating ad angles for different products

* Editing Meta ad videos for Instagram and

* Creating multiple variations of the same ad

* Organizing raw footage by product, hook, angle, lifestyle, founder clips, UGC, BTS, and product shots

* Turning raw footage into short, engaging ad videos

* Creating different first 3-second hooks

* Understanding how to edit for paid ad performance

* Working with notes from our ad agency

* Communicating through Slack or WhatsApp

* Reviewing what types of ads are working and suggesting new creative ideas

* Helping us test different ad styles, hooks, pacing, and formats



- Type of Ads

The content may include:

* Product-focused ads

* Lifestyle ads

* Founder/talking-head ads

* UGC-style ads

* Behind-the-scenes clips

* Drop announcement ads

* Outfit/styling ads

* Brand-building ads



For example, one hoodie may need multiple ad angles such as:

* Quality/material angle

* Limited drop angle

* Outfit/styling angle

* Founder story angle

* Lifestyle/brand feeling angle



- Ad Structure

You should understand basic direct-response ad structure:

Hook ? Problem/desire ? Product/value ? Proof ? CTA



You DO NOT need to write full ad copy, captions, headlines, or primary text.



However, you should understand how hooks and CTAs work inside the video edit. The edit should make people stop scrolling, understand the product, feel the brand, and want to click.



- Weekly Content Planning

We want someone who can help create a weekly content/ad plan.



For example, you may suggest:

* 3 product ads

* 2 founder ads

* 2 lifestyle ads

* 3 different hook variations

* 2 new angles for a specific product

* 1 retargeting-style ad

* 1 hype/drop ad



We do not want to put a strict cap on the number of ads. The goal is to create as many strong ad variations as possible while keeping quality high.



- Editing Style

The videos should feel clean, stylish, and on-brand.

We want someone with good taste who understands fashion, streetwear, lifestyle, and premium branding.

The ads should not feel cheap, corny, or overly edited. They should feel natural, engaging, and made for paid social.



- Software

We are open to any editing software as long as the final work is high quality.

Examples:

* CapCut

* Premiere Pro

* Final Cut Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Canva



- Requirements

You should have experience with:

* Editing Meta ads

* Instagram/Facebook ad creatives

* Product videos

* UGC-style content

* Lifestyle content

* Creating multiple ad variations

* Understanding hooks and CTAs

* Organizing footage

* Working with raw footage

* Planning weekly content ideas

* Fashion, streetwear, or lifestyle brands

* Paid social content



Experience understanding Meta ad performance is preferred but not required.

It is a plus if you understand metrics such as:

* CTR

* Hook rate

* Hold rate

* CPA

* ROAS

* Add to cart

* Purchases



- Schedule

This is a part-time role.

We will start part-time and increase responsibilities if the fit is strong.

Communication will mainly happen through Slack or WhatsApp. You may also receive notes from our ad agency.



- Pay

This is a monthly part-time role.

Pay will depend on experience, quality, and skill level.

We are looking for someone who can grow with the brand and become a key part of our creative process.

$$We enjoy paying our team well$$



- Test Task

Top applicants may be asked to complete a sample task.

For the test task, we will provide raw footage and ask you to create 3 different ad variations from the same footage:

1. One product-focused ad

2. One lifestyle/brand-focused ad

3. One founder/UGC-style ad



This will help us see how you think through hooks, pacing, angles, structure, and ad creative.



- How To Apply

Please send:

1. A short summary of your experience

2. Examples of Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads you have edited

3. Examples of product, UGC, lifestyle, or founder-style ads

4. Any examples of weekly content/ad plans you have created

5. Your editing software

6. Your internet speed

7. Your computer specs

8. Your availability per week

9. Your monthly rate for part-time work

10. A short Loom video explaining your experience and walking through one ad creative you edited

11. Any performance results from past ads, if available



Put the word “META” in your subject line so we know you read the full post.



Generic applications will be ignored. We are looking for someone who understands ad creative, fashion/lifestyle content, and how to make videos that are built to test and perform.

We want an honest worker who works hard and helps the company. We want to take care of you and if you are a hard worker, you will very quickly rise to become our CS Manager (this position is vacant now!) and you will be put on a ~$750-$1000 monthly retainer plus bonus and supervise other reps.



ABOUT US

We run on Shopify. And you will be doing support inside of GMAIL



WHAT YOU WILL DO AT THE START

You will answer customer
s covering refunds, order status, shipping questions, product questions, and subscription issues.

You will process refunds inside Shopify.

You will cancel, pause, and reschedule subscriptions inside Loop.

You will respond to chargeback disputes by gathering evidence and building a clear written record.

You will work from our templates and SOPs, and when a template is not working, you will tell us and help rewrite it.

Full training is provided. Experience with Shopify and Loop is a plus, but we will teach the right person.



WHAT THE ROLE BECOMES

If you perform, you will take full ownership of the inbox without supervision.

You will write the SOPs that future hires follow.

You will help hire, train, and review other support representatives.

You will report on refund rate, first response time, and the reasons customers cancel.

Over time you will manage a small support team, and you will have a voice in decisions about our offers and our product, because you will understand our customers better than anyone else in the company.



PAY AND GROWTH

You start at $5/hour, working a few hours per day, paid weekly through [Wise / Deel / PayPal].

After 90 days of consistent performance, pay increases to $7/hour with hours per day changing with demand.

As a senior representative//CS manager pay increases to a fixed $750-$1000 monthly retainer or higher + bonuses



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Written English strong enough that a US customer would read your replies as native.

Composure under pressure. You can receive an angry
 and write the reply that keeps the customer.



***Complete honesty in logging your hours. This is not negotiable. Anyone found misreporting time is let go immediately.



A reliable internet connection and consistent availability during the required hours.

Responsiveness on whatsapp.

Initiative. You solve problems rather than waiting to be told.

Willingness to tell us when something we wrote is wrong.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

Someone splitting their attention across several other clients.

Someone who needs a manager to be on their ass throughout the day.

Someone who pastes AI-generated text into a customer reply without reading it first.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

Full training, written SOPs, and ready-to-use
 templates.

Direct access to the founders. Your questions go straight to Krishan or Ben. There is no layer between you and the people who own the company.



HOW TO APPLY

Send both of the following. Applications missing any part will not be reviewed.



One, your written reply to the customer

"Subject: this is a scam. I ordered 3 months ago and it did nothing. I
ed to cancel my subscription on the 4th and you charged me on the 6th anyway. I already called my bank. Refund me now or I am posting this everywhere."

An AI-powered lead generation system built for Home Services businesses (painters, remodelers, and similar trades). The system generates leads, qualifies them with AI voice + text agents, and books appointments directly on our clients' calendars. It works. We took one painter from $295K/year to $1.5M in 14 months. This is consistent, focused work. You'll be working warm inbound leads AND running outbound to home services business owners. Your one job: get qualified decision-makers on the calendar. A closer handles the rest. Most people don't have the discipline for this. The ones who do will earn well and grow with us.



Your Mission:

- Work inbound leads fast - speed to lead is everything.

- Run outbound to home services business owners (phone + text + LinkedIn).

You'll report directly to the owner and coordinate periodically with our outside CPA firm.



Key Responsibilities:

Property Acquisitions & Dispositions:

Book all purchase and sale closing/settlement statements (HUD-1 or Closing Disclosure) correctly — purchase price, prorated taxes, prorated rent, earnest money application, loan proceeds/payoffs, title fees, recording fees, commissions, etc.

Move properties on and off the balance sheet at the correct time and in the correct account (fixed asset for rental holds vs. inventory for flip/wholesale properties)

Set up new property sub-accounts/classes at acquisition and close them out cleanly at disposition



Renovation & Repair Categorization:

Correctly distinguish and categorize repairs & maintenance (expense) vs. capital improvements (capitalized to the asset) on every renovation invoice

Track capitalized renovation costs by property for accurate basis at sale or for depreciation schedules

Flag ambiguous items for owner/CPA review rather than guessing



Monthly Close & Reporting:

Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts monthly

Maintain clean, audit-ready QuickBooks files that our CPA firm can work from directly at tax time



Multi-Entity Coordination:

Correctly allocate shared expenses across entities where applicable

Keep intercompany transactions properly tracked and reconciled

Maintain consistent chart of accounts and class/location structure across all four entities



Required Qualifications:

Minimum 3+ years of bookkeeping experience specifically for real estate investors, flippers, or property management companies (not just general small business bookkeeping)

Demonstrated hands-on experience booking real estate closing/settlement statements

Strong working knowledge of the difference between repair expense and capital expenditure treatment

Experience managing books across multiple related entities/classes in QBO

Reliable internet connection and ability to work US Eastern Time overlap hours for at least part of the week



How to apply:

Send the following to 

A short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and walking through your real estate bookkeeping experience

A specific example of a closing/settlement statement you've booked (describe the line items and how you categorized them — no need to share confidential client data)

title: Retention Manager / Subscription Data Analyst — 8-Figure Supplement Brand
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical Retention Manager / Subscription Data Analyst to own customer retention, churn reduction, and LTV growth for an 8-figure supplement brand.



This person will not be responsible for making ads, building funnels, or writing copy. Their job is to deeply understand our subscription data, find the leaks in our cohorts, and create clear strategies to keep customers longer — especially past month three.



The main goal of this role is simple: ????Increase LTV, reduce churn, and improve the LTV:CAC ratio.



Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for analyzing subscription performance across the full customer lifecycle and identifying where customers are dropping off.



This includes:

- Reviewing cohort data to understand month 1, month 2, month 3, and month 4+ retention.

- Identifying churn points and figuring out why customers are cancelling, failing to rebill, refunding, or dropping off.

- Analyzing how different front-end offers, pricing structures, bundles, marketing angles, funnels, and customer segments - lead to different LTVs.

- Working with the
/SMS team to develop post-purchase flows that educate customers, increase product usage, reduce buyer’s remorse, and improve rebill rates.

- Building and improving cancellation flows, save offers, pause options, skip options, product education, and customer feedback loops.

- Creating feedback surveys to understand why customers cancel, refund, or stop engaging with the product.

- Turning customer feedback and cohort data into actionable retention strategies.

- Monitoring key subscription metrics daily, weekly, and monthly.

- Working with the customer support team to identify common cancellation reasons, refund reasons, product complaints, - confusion points, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

- Helping the team understand which customers, offers, and angles create the highest-quality subscribers.

- Building retention reports, dashboards, and clear recommendations for leadership.



Key Metrics You Will Own:

You should be comfortable tracking and improving:

- Month 1 retention

- Month 2 retention

- Month 3 retention

- Month 4+ retention

- Subscription take rate

- Rebill success rate

- Failed payment rate

- Churn rate

- Refund rate

- Chargeback rate

- LTV

- LTV:CAC ratio

- CAC payback window

- Customer cohort performance

- Retention by offer

- Retention by marketing angle

- Retention by funnel

- Retention by product bundle

- Retention by customer segment



Must-Have Experience: You must have:

- Experience working with an 8-figure ecommerce brand.

- Experience working with a supplement brand.

- Strong understanding of subscription ecommerce and recurring revenue models.

- Strong understanding of LTV:CAC, contribution margin, cohort retention, churn, and CAC payback.

- Proven experience reducing churn and increasing customer LTV.

- Experience analyzing retention data and turning it into clear action.

- Experience working with Shopify.

- Ability to work closely with
/SMS, customer support, media buying, CRO, and operations teams.

- Strong understanding of post-purchase education, customer onboarding, cancellation flows, and save strategies.

- Ability to create structured hypotheses, prioritize retention tests, and clearly track outcomes.



Nice to Have:

- Experience with Checkout Champ.

- Experience with Recharge, Skio, Stay AI, Loop, or other subscription management platforms.

- Experience with Klaviyo or similar
/SMS platforms.

- Experience with direct response supplement offers.

- Experience improving rebill approval rates and failed payment recovery.

- Experience with customer surveys, cancellation surveys, and voice-of-customer analysis.

- Experience building retention dashboards and reporting systems.



What Success Looks Like: You will be successful in this role if you can:

- Clearly identify where the biggest retention leaks are.

- Improve month 1, month 2, and month 3 retention.

- Help customers understand the product better after purchase.

- Reduce preventable cancellations and refunds.

- Improve failed payment recovery.

- Help us understand which front-end offers and marketing angles bring in the highest-LTV customers.

- Create a repeatable system for testing retention improvements.

- Turn retention data into clear strategies that increase profit.



Who This Role Is Not For:  

This is not a generic
 marketing role.



This is not a customer support role.



This is not a media buying or funnel-building role.



We need someone who can look at subscription data, find the leaks, understand why customers are churning, and create a clear plan to improve retention.



If you only think about open rates, click rates, or surface-level
 metrics, this is not the right role.

We need someone who thinks in terms of: Cohorts, churn, LTV, CAC payback, rebill rates, customer education, offer quality, and subscription profitability.

title: Senior Graphic Designer — Billboard
description:
# Senior Graphic Designer — Billboard / Out-of-Home (Print & Digital Production)



 Project-based to start (45+ billboard designs), with ongoing work for the right person



---



 We need an experienced large-format / out-of-home (OOH) designer to turn our brand templates and approved copy into print-ready and digital-ready billboard artwork for a multi-board campaign thanking U.S. members of Congress — about **15 officials × 3 message variations = 45+ boards** — plus ongoing campaigns after this one.



You will take our existing concepts, brand colors (navy/gold), copy, and portrait photos and build **vendor-ready files for Lamar, Clear Channel Outdoor, and OUTFRONT**. This is real print-production work — not social media graphics — so you must understand building at scale, CMYK, bleed/safety areas, and how to package files to a vendor spec sheet.



## What you'll do



- Design and produce **14? × 48? static bulletin** and **digital bulletin** artwork from our brand template and copy.

- Build every file to the **exact vendor spec sheet** (size, scale, resolution, color mode, bleed, safety area) for Lamar / Clear Channel Outdoor / OUTFRONT.

- Professionally **cut out / mask portrait photos** (clean edges on hair and shoulders) and composite them onto brand backgrounds.

- Maintain a **consistent template system** across 45+ variations using master files, smart objects, and styles.

- Apply OOH best practices: short readable copy (?7 words), large legible type, high contrast, correct legal disclaimer placement.

- Prepare **print-ready packaged files** (CMYK, outlined fonts, embedded/linked images, PDF/X export) and **RGB digital JPGs**.

- Source or recommend **high-resolution photography** where our supplied images are too small for print.

- Handle revisions, proofs, and "overage" copy; hit vendor deadlines (copy is typically due ~10 working days before a board runs).



## Required skills & experience



- **3+ years** professional graphic design with **real large-format / OOH / billboard or print-production experience** (portfolio required).

- **Expert in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop** (InDesign a plus).

- Strong **typography and layout** — you understand legibility at distance.

- Professional **photo cutout / masking / retouching**.

- Solid **print production** knowledge: CMYK, resolution-at-scale (building 1 inch = 1 foot), bleed & safety area, rich black, packaging files, and PDF/X export.

- Understanding of **digital OOH** requirements: RGB, exact pixel dimensions, static-only (no animation).

- **High attention to detail** and the discipline to follow exact spec sheets.

- **Good written English** and responsive, reliable communication.



## Bonus points



- Experience with **U.S. political / advocacy / issue advertising**.

- Experience working directly to **Lamar / Clear Channel Outdoor / OUTFRONT** specs.

- Comfort **sourcing and licensing high-resolution stock or photography**.

- Basic **motion / DOOH** skills (a plus, not required).



## Tools you'll need



- Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator + Photoshop required; InDesign a plus)

- Reliable internet and computer capable of handling large print files

- File sharing (Google Drive / Dropbox)



## Reference — the specs you'll build to



| | Static 14?×48? bulletin | Digital bulletin |

|---|---|---|

| Build scale | 1 inch = 1 foot | Pixel-exact |

| File size | ~49? × 15? trim (1? bleed); 48? × 14? live/safety | 1400 × 400 px (varies per board) |

| Resolution | 150 ppi at scaled size | 72 dpi |

| Color mode | CMYK | sRGB / RGB |

| Format | High-res packaged PDF, fonts outlined | High-res JPG |

| Motion | n/a | Static only, no animation |



*(Exact specs vary by board — you must read and follow each vendor's individual spec sheet.)*



---



## How to apply — please read carefully (we filter applications)



1. **Start your message with the word "BULLETIN"** so we know you read the full post.

2. Send your **portfolio link**, and point us to any **billboard / large-format / OOH / print** work specifically.

3. In 2–3 sentences, explain **the difference between preparing a static 14×48 bulletin file vs. a digital bulletin file** (think color mode, scale/resolution, format).

4. Tell us your **availability** and your **rate** (and whether you prefer hourly, monthly, or per-board).



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.



## Paid test (shortlisted candidates only)



We'll invite finalists to a **small paid test**: using a portrait, copy, and brand colors we provide, deliver —

- **(a)** a print-ready **14? × 48? bulletin** built at 1 inch = 1 foot, **150 ppi, CMYK**, with 1? bleed and a correct 48?×14? safety area, exported as a packaged print **PDF**; and

- **(b)** a **1400 × 400 px, sRGB digital bulletin JPG** of the same design.



We pay for the test and review the files for spec accuracy, type legibility, and clean photo cutouts.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist / Ecommerce CRO
description:
**Title: Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist / Ecommerce CRO**



We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented **Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist** to help improve the performance of our ecommerce funnels, landing pages, checkout flow, product pages, and offers.



This role is ideal for someone who understands ecommerce, direct response marketing, user behavior, analytics, and testing. You do not need to be a designer or developer, but you should be able to clearly identify what is hurting conversion and recommend practical improvements.



**Responsibilities:**



* Review ecommerce websites, landing pages, product pages, carts, and checkout flows

* Identify friction points that reduce conversion rates

* Create CRO recommendations based on data, user behavior, and best practices

* Analyze metrics such as conversion rate, AOV, bounce rate, add-to-cart rate, checkout completion, and revenue per session

* Help plan A/B tests and track results

* Research competitors and high-performing ecommerce funnels

* Work with designers, developers, media buyers, and leadership to improve performance

* Create clear reports with findings, priorities, and next steps

* Suggest improvements to page structure, copy, offers, trust signals, pricing, bundles, upsells, and checkout flow



**Requirements:**



* Experience with ecommerce CRO, landing pages, Shopify, or direct response funnels

* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

* Comfortable using tools like Google Analytics, Shopify analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Triple Whale, VWO, Optimizely, or similar tools

* Good understanding of buyer psychology, copywriting, UX, and funnel performance

* Able to explain recommendations clearly in writing

* Proactive and able to find problems without being micromanaged

* Reliable, organized, and consistent



**Nice to Have:**



* Experience with Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Triple Whale, Meta ads, Google ads, or
/SMS funnels

* Experience creating CRO audit reports

* Basic wireframing skills using Figma, Canva, Google Slides, or similar tools

* Experience with beauty, supplement, health, apparel, or consumer product brands



**What We Value:**



We want someone who thinks like an owner. Do not just complete tasks — look for problems, suggest improvements, and help us make better decisions. We value clear thinking, honest reporting, and practical execution.



**To Apply:**



Please send:



1. A short introduction about your CRO/ecommerce experience

2. Examples of CRO audits, landing pages, funnels, or tests you have worked on

3. Your experience with analytics or heatmap tools

4. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary

5. Your availability and preferred working hours

6. Your MBTI type, if you know it



Please include the word **“CONVERSION”** in your application so we know you read the full post.

mber who loves talking to people and keeping things organized. This is a relationship-first role - you'll be the friendly, consistent voice that keeps our leads warm and moving forward.
