title: Supply Chain and Logistics Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

The Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator is responsible for monitoring inbound shipments, coordinating with suppliers and freight partners, maintaining shipment visibility, ensuring timely document flow, and providing operational reports to support business continuity and inventory availability.



Key Responsibilities

1. Shipment Monitoring & Tracking

• Monitor all inbound shipments from supplier dispatch through final delivery. 

• Maintain and update shipment tracking reports. 

• Provide regular shipment status updates to management. 

• Identify and escalate shipment delays, missing documentation, and logistics issues. 

• Follow up with suppliers, freight forwarders, brokers, and warehouses regarding shipment progress. 

2. Logistics Coordination

• Coordinate shipment schedules with suppliers and logistics partners. 

• Track container movements and air shipments. 

• Assist in managing shipping timelines and expected arrival dates. 

• Ensure all parties are informed of shipment status changes. 

3. Documentation Management

• Collect, organize, and maintain shipment documentation, including: 

o Commercial Invoices 

o Packing Lists 

o Bills of Lading 

o Air Waybills 

o Customs documents 

• Verify completeness of shipping documents before clearance. 

• Coordinate document submission to brokers and relevant stakeholders. 

4. Operational Reporting

• Prepare shipment status reports and logistics summaries. 

• Maintain shipment trackers and operational dashboards. 

• Provide management with updates on pending, delayed, and completed shipments. 

• Assist in data gathering and reporting for business operations. 

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

• Liaise with suppliers, freight forwarders, brokers, warehouses, and internal teams. 

• Follow up on outstanding actions required for shipment movement and clearance. 

• Support resolution of logistics and documentation issues. 

6. Process Improvement

• Recommend improvements to shipment tracking and reporting processes. 

• Assist in maintaining accurate logistics records and operational procedures. 

• Support implementation of supply chain tracking tools and systems. 

7. Business Support Projects

• Conduct supplier and service provider research as requested.

title: Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA
description:
WISE SCOUT



RECRUITMENT OPERATIONS & CLIENT SUCCESS VA



Remote · Full-Time

ABOUT WISE SCOUT



Wise Scout is a recruitment firm that helps small and growing businesses find and hire exceptional remote talent, primarily in the Philippines. We're a small, tight-knit team that does meaningful work: we match the right people with the right opportunities and help businesses build teams they're genuinely proud of.

We're a caring, lighthearted team that believes work should be purposeful but not all-consuming. We care about our families, our people, and doing things well. If you've ever wanted to be part of a company where you're treated as a person first — this is that place.

We're growing, and this hire is a critical next step. The person who steps into this role won't just support the work, they'll help shape how we operate and eventually build a team of their own.



ROLE OVERVIEW



We're looking for a Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA to be the operational engine behind Wise Scout's hiring pipelines and client relationships. This is a role for someone who loves moving things forward; who sees a task and gets it done without waiting to be told twice.

You'll own the day-to-day execution of our recruitment process: setting up client meetings, building assessment pipelines, posting jobs, filtering candidates, tracking progress, and keeping clients informed every step of the way. You'll also support internal HR for our staff and jump into client-facing calls when needed.

This isn't a role where you'll wait for perfect instructions. We have processes — many of them — but they're still being refined. You'll need to be comfortable stepping into some ambiguity, figuring out what the next step is, and moving forward. If that excites you, you'll thrive here.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This role requires meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours, as client meetings and internal team calls happen in U.S. time zones.



- At least half of your working hours must be available during U.S. business hours in the Central time zone. During busy weeks, around a quarter of your hours will be spent in the U.S. Central time afternoons (between 12–4am PHT)

- Weekly all-hands meeting with the full Wise Scout team (Tuesdays 2pm CST/3am PHT)

- Weekly operational sync with Hiring Coordinator to drive hiring pipelines forward

- Schedule is otherwise flexible; we trust you to manage your time and deliver results





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



This role is broad but focused. Here are the five core areas you'll be responsible for:



1. CLIENT COMMUNICATION & RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT



- Set up and schedule intro calls with new clients; follow up with meeting notes, to-dos, and next steps

- Maintain consistent, professional communication with clients throughout the hiring process

- Send follow-up check-ins over days and weeks to stay top of mind with prospective clients

- Represent Wise Scout warmly and confidently in
 and on video calls

- Potentially run intro meetings and hiring calls with clients independently over time





2. HIRING PIPELINE MANAGEMENT



- Build and manage assessment pipelines in Criteria Corp for each active role

- Write experience questionnaires: self-assessment quizzes designed to quantify a candidate's background through how they answer, not just what they say

- Post job descriptions across multiple job boards

- Download and score applicants in spreadsheets; filter to top candidates based on scores and answers

- Move candidates through each stage of the pipeline with clear documentation and communication





3. RECRUITMENT REPORTING & TRACKING



- Maintain a master tracking spreadsheet showing all open roles, current stage, and time-in-process for each

- Upload data and report regularly to leadership on pipeline health: how many applicants, who's moving forward, and where things stand

- Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between steps or between client touchpoints





4. JOB DESCRIPTION WRITING



- Use AI tools (and interview notes) to draft compelling, accurate job descriptions for each client role

- Collaborate with team to refine and finalize before posting





5. INTERNAL HR & STAFF SUPPORT



- Check in regularly with Wise Scout's internal staff to gauge workload, morale, and needs

- Answer basic technical questions about Slack, 
, and other internal tools

- Track team hours in 
, compile timesheets, and submit payroll through 

- Support onboarding of new hires as the team grows





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Skills and tools can be taught. What we can't teach is the right wiring. Here's what that looks like for this role:



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU:



- Are self-directed; you see what needs to happen next, and you do it

- Love checking things off a list and moving tasks forward without being prompted

- Are detail-oriented without being paralyzed by perfectionism — 90% shipped beats 100% stuck

- Communicate openly and confidently, both in writing and on video calls

- Are comfortable making mistakes and talking about them honestly, so the team can move on

- Solve problems independently; you Google it, look at how it was done before, and figure it out

- Enjoy understanding the whole process, not just your piece of it

- Can hold a lot of moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF YOU:



- Need clear, step-by-step instructions for everything before you can act

- Are uncomfortable with ambiguity or imperfect processes

- Avoid difficult conversations or are reluctant to give or receive direct feedback

- Struggle to communicate confidently with clients or leadership

- Get overwhelmed when managing multiple tasks or clients at once





TOOLS YOU'LL WORK WITH



You must arrive proficient in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Gmail. Everything else can be learned on the job.



- Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Meet (must-have on day one)

- Slack: internal team communication

- Criteria Corp: assessment and hiring pipeline tool (we'll train you)

- 
: time tracking for internal staff

- QuickBooks Online: bookkeeping and invoicing (light exposure helpful)

- 
: payroll and payments

title: Outbound Marketing Owner
description:
We're a U.S. recruiting / RPO business serving manufacturing leaders, and we're looking for someone to own our outbound marketing end to end — not run a script we hand you, but build, drive, and improve the entire engine that turns a list of target companies into booked conversations.



This is a role for an owner, not an executor. We'll point you at our market (~1,500 priority manufacturing accounts) and the outcome we want (real conversations with decision-makers), and you bring the strategy, the tools, and the judgment to get there. If you need to be told each step, this isn't for you. If you've been wanting full ownership of an outreach function — and a direct line between your performance and your pay — keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:



The whole outbound engine — strategy, targeting, messaging, channels, and execution. You own the number: booked meetings with qualified decision-makers.



Strategy & ideas — you're expected to bring new tools, channels, and angles to the table, test them, and tell us what's working. We want to learn from you, not just direct you.



Targeted research & personalization — we're quality-over-volume (~100 deeply-researched leads/week against our priority accounts, each with a real, specific hook), not mass-blasting. You know how to find the signal that earns a reply.



Campaign execution — build and run sequences (we use Instantly; open to your recommendations), test relentlessly, and optimize toward replies and meetings, not send volume.



The technical backend — still extremely important and non-negotiable. You own deliverability: sending domains, mailboxes, DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, custom tracking domains), warmup, rotation, and inbox-health monitoring. Setup is front-loaded; keeping placement high is ongoing. If the
s don't hit the inbox, nothing else matters.



Tooling — Apollo, Clay / Claygent, verification, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and whatever else you can justify. Recommend the stack; we'll resource what works.



WHO YOU ARE:



- You've owned outbound or lead-gen before and can point to meetings or deals you drove — not just campaigns you ran.

- Confident you can land conversations, and comfortable being measured on it.

- A builder and problem-solver who brings ideas rather than waiting for instructions.

- Deep on
 infrastructure and deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, 2024+ Google/Yahoo sender rules) — a hard requirement.

- Strong with modern outbound tooling (Apollo, Clay, Instantly / Smartlead) and quick to evaluate new ones.

- Fluent written English, sharp judgment, and genuine attention to detail.



COMPENSATION:



$5–10 / hour USD to start, depending on experience — part-time initially. This is a starting point: strong performance moves you up — more hours, a higher base rate, and bigger upside on every meeting and deal you drive.



Booked-meeting bonuses:

- Meetings 1–20: $20 each

- Meetings 21–40: $30 each

- Meetings 41+: $40 each (cap)



Deal bonuses — once you've hit the meeting cap, you earn on outcomes: $100–$500 per deal that converts into a completed search, scaled by deal size.



A "qualified meeting" = a target decision-maker (VP / Director of Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Plant Manager, President / COO) who attends a genuine fit conversation. No-shows and unqualified contacts don't count.



HOW TO APPLY:



Send the following:

1. A short note on how you'd approach owning outbound for a recruiting business targeting manufacturers — your angle, your first moves, and the tools you'd reach for.

2. A specific result you've personally driven (meetings or deals), with rough numbers.

3. Screenshots from Instantly / Smartlead showing your reply rates and inbox health.

4. Your answer to: what's the difference between DMARC p=none, p=quarantine, and p=reject, and which do you use during warmup?

5. Your rate and availability.



Generic applications won't be considered. We're looking for an owner — show us how you think.



GenioSys | Recruiting built for manufacturers | geniosys.ai

? Confidence to work independently and efficiently.

? Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

? Ability to stay organised and manage time well, working on multiple projects/executions

while maintaining the highest standard of quality.

? A cool, calm, and collected approach to problem-solving.



Our Values:

and foundation of our company. Every action we take is for the purpose of delivering the best

own it. We always ask “what would make this a better experience for the client”. We associate

ourselves with the work we deliver and want to leave the best impression. Clients are the first

and most important thing in our business which allow us to do what we do.



Be The Best: We have a strong desire to be the best we can be. Not just in work but in all areas

of your life. You want to be the healthiest version of yourself. You want to be the best father,

mother, husband, son, daughter you can be. We value the ability to learn, grow and develop and

work, we lean into it. You’ll never hear us say, “That’s not my job.” By being proactive with our

skillset we place ourselves in a position to influence the world around us in a way that only

those who understand true responsibility ever can. We are a team of high performers. We push

each other to do better and hold each other accountable. ALWAYS giving feedback to those

around us. We grow faster together.



Have Fun: We have fun every single day. We enjoy the process and we don’t take ourselves

too seriously. Understanding that we’re all striving for the same mission and that everyone on

the team is also pushing themselves, we take time to appreciate the journey. We spend time

laughing and having fun on calls. We approach every situation, task and meeting with a

s and messages when needed

title: Social Media Coordinator/Community Manager
description:
Purpose 

The Offshore Social Media Coordinator / Community Manager is responsible for scheduling, publishing, monitoring, organizing, and reporting on approved Alarmed Media LLC content across assigned social platforms. This role helps turn content into audience insight by tracking performance, monitoring comments and direct messages, identifying audience questions, and escalating sensitive items. This is not a clinical role and does not provide therapy, diagnosis, crisis counseling, or individualized treatment advice. 



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting 

- Publish or schedule at least 95% of approved posts on time according to the assigned content calendar. 

- Maintain 100% compliance with the approval workflow by posting only approved content, captions, links, hashtags, and platform versions. 

- Review assigned platforms, comments, mentions, and direct messages at least twice per business day or according to the assigned monitoring schedule. 

- Identify at least 10 strong comment-reply video opportunities weekly and add them to the content tracker. 

- Capture at least 25 audience questions, pain points, objections, or recurring themes monthly for content planning. 

- Submit weekly analytics reports on time at least 95% of the time and monthly analytics reports on time 100% of the time. 

- Track every posted video with platform, posting date, caption, link, status, views, engagement, comments, shares, saves, follower change, and other available metrics. 

- Maintain zero unauthorized posts, wrong-version posts, public PHI disclosures, public treatment-relationship confirmations, clinical advice responses, or unapproved crisis responses. 

- Escalate urgent, clinical, privacy, legal, complaint, crisis, OAC-related, or reputation-risk items immediately according to the escalation process. 

- Complete at least one social workflow, analytics, response-template, tracking, or scheduling-process improvement quarterly. 

- Upon achieving these key performance indicators, the supervisor will meet with the contractor to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth, quality, and accountability. 



Core Competencies 

- Demonstrate strong social media scheduling, platform management, caption adaptation, community monitoring, and analytics tracking skill. 

- Demonstrate professional judgment, emotional maturity, and clear boundaries when reviewing comments and messages from vulnerable or distressed individuals. 

- Demonstrate strong organization, attention to detail, file/link accuracy, and deadline follow-through. 

- Demonstrate the ability to identify audience language, recurring questions, and content opportunities from comments and platform performance. 

- Demonstrate strict confidentiality and appropriate escalation of sensitive information. 



Core Responsibilities 

– These duties may vary depending on project assignments and Company needs. 

- Schedule and publish approved content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn, and other assigned platforms. 

- Confirm that the correct video version, caption, title, thumbnail, hashtags, links, and platform settings are used before posting. 

- Adapt captions and titles for each platform while preserving accuracy, tone, and approved messaging. 

- Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, shares, tags, and audience engagement according to assigned schedules. 

- Organize audience questions, objections, pain points, and story ideas by theme for future content planning. 

- Identify comments that may become strong reply videos, FAQs, carousels, podcast topics, or long-form video topics. 

- Maintain and update social media performance trackers, dashboards, content logs, and platform links. 

- Escalate crisis comments, clinical questions, legal complaints, privacy concerns, OAC-related questions, spam, threats, harassment, or reputation issues according to approved rules. 

- Use only approved response templates and do not provide clinical advice, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, crisis counseling, or individualized guidance. 

- Coordinate with the Content Producer and Video Editor to confirm posting readiness and resolve platform or asset issues. 

- Perform other duties as assigned commensurate with the position duties. 

- Adhere to all Alarmed Media LLC policies, confidentiality rules, contractor agreements, and platform-access standards. 



Required Qualifications 

- 1–3+ years of experience managing or supporting social media accounts, content calendars, posting schedules, community management, or analytics preferred. 

- Experience with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, LinkedIn, and/or scheduling tools preferred. 

- Strong written English and ability to adapt captions, titles, comments, and reporting summaries professionally. 

- Experience working with personal brands, educational content, healthcare, mental health, coaching, nonprofits, or mission-driven organizations preferred. 

- Strong spreadsheet, tracking, and reporting skills required. 

- Reliable internet access, secure computer practices, and ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment required.

title: Music Catalog Producer & Audio Assets Manager
description:
Ventured Entertainment is seeking an organized, efficient Music Catalog Producer & Audio Assets Manager to spearhead the expansion of our master instrumental library. This is a highly specialized technical production role. You will not be making tracks from scratch; instead, you will function as our digital audio architect—sourcing, downloading, arranging, and meticulously archiving premium music construction kits into a massive, commercially ready instrumental catalog.



The ideal candidate has a strong background in music production, a deep understanding of song structure across multiple genres, and an obsession with file organization. You must have a fast internet connection, heavy file-download capabilities, and mastery of a modern Digital Audio Workstation (DAW).



Scope of Responsibilities

Asset Acquisition & Downloading: Utilize company-provided access to Rapidgator and specialized audio curation sites to efficiently download targeted music construction kits.



Audio Arrangement & Stitching: Analyze the downloaded construction kits. If a full-length instrumental is not already included, you will import the individual stems/loops into your DAW (Logic, FL Studio, Pro Tools, etc.) and professionally arrange, mix, and sequence them into a complete, cohesive 2-to-3-minute instrumental track.



Catalog Curation & Genre Sorting: Accurately classify every completed track by its exact genre (e.g., Hip-Hop, R&B, Grunge, Pop) and ensure it meets our quality standards.



Meticulous Google Drive Management: Maintain a highly organized, standardized cloud storage system. You will upload, name, and archive the full wave file instrumentals into their designated genre folders within our master Google Drive catalog.



Requirements & Technical Qualifications

DAW Mastery: High proficiency in at least one professional Digital Audio Workstation (e.g., Logic Pro, FL Studio, Ableton Live, Pro Tools, Cubase).



Music Production & Arrangement Skills: A sharp ear for tempo, key, and arrangement. You must know how to take fragmented loops/stems and smoothly arrange them so they sound like a naturally flowing, radio-ready instrumental.



Data & File Management Capabilities: You must have the hardware capacity and a high-speed internet connection capable of handling heavy daily download volumes from Rapidgator and large uploads to Google Drive.



Extreme Attention to Detail: Obsessive about file naming conventions, folder structures, and digital organization.

Self-Discipline & Speed: Ability to work independently, manage your own production workflow, and consistently hit catalog volume targets without sacrificing audio quality.

title: Content Strategist/Social Media Team
description:
We are hiring a full-time Content Strategist + Social Media Manager to help drive growth and revenue across Instagram,
, Linkedin and TikTok.



This is not an entry-level social media role, and it is not a “just keep the content calendar full” position.



We are looking for someone who has already helped brands grow and monetize through short vertical video, can clearly explain how they did it, and can step into an established personal brand with both strategy and execution skills.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, 
 and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



Our business includes:



low-ticket offers and live challenges

webinars and launch campaigns

a membership

a flagship course and higher-ticket offers



We are a systems-driven team with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards. We move fast, especially during launch periods, and we are looking for someone who can keep up, think strategically, and execute without needing constant direction.



What This Role Actually Is



This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, conversion strategy, and day-to-day social media execution.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to post content.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use content to:



grow the right audience

build trust and authority

support active offers

convert attention into leads and sales

create a repeatable content system the team can execute consistently



You should be able to think like a strategist and work like an operator.



What We Are Looking For



You are likely a fit if the following describes you:



1) You have a real content strategy framework



You do not “wing it” or rely on random content ideas.



You have a repeatable process for:



auditing a brand, its audience, and its offers

identifying what content should drive reach vs trust vs conversion

building content pillars and campaign-specific content plans

turning strategy into hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, and content direction

reviewing performance and adjusting based on what the data says



We are not looking for vague “I help brands show up consistently” language.

We want someone who can clearly explain how you build a content strategy that drives business results.



2) You have proof that your work has driven both growth and revenue



We are looking for someone who has helped brands grow accounts and support monetization.



That means you should be able to show:



accounts you have worked on

what the numbers looked like before you got involved

what changed after your strategy was implemented

how your content supported lead generation, launches, offer sales, or conversions



Views and followers are not enough on their own. We care about business impact.



3) You understand short vertical video deeply



You should have strong working knowledge of:



TikTok

LinkedIn

Instagram Reels

 content strategy



You should understand that content cannot simply be reposted everywhere without thought. We want someone who knows how to think strategically about each platform while still creating a cohesive overall brand content system.



4) You can execute what you strategize



This is not a strategy-only role.



You should be comfortable actually doing the work required to move the strategy forward, including:



developing weekly content direction

writing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs

organizing and managing content calendars

scheduling and publishing content

adjusting content during launches and promotions

collaborating with the founder and internal team on what gets created next



5) You are highly organized and proactive



We move quickly. You should be someone who:



meets deadlines without being chased

communicates proactively

can work inside structured systems

can keep multiple moving pieces organized during launch periods

is comfortable collaborating with a founder who is also a strategist

What This Role Involves



Your responsibilities will include:



Deep diving into the Keenya Kelly brand, including audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors

Developing a content strategy based on where the brand is going, not just what has been posted before

Delivering weekly content direction for Instagram, LinkedIn,
, and TikTok

Creating hooks, script direction, captions, and CTAs tied to active offers

Delivering one Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram

Managing day-to-day content execution on the accounts you are directing

Scheduling and publishing content

Building and maintaining a content system the team can use, including:

competitor tracking

content ideas and hook libraries

campaign content planning

content direction frameworks

Joining bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle

Adapting quickly during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaign periods

You Are the Right Fit If…

You have a documented, repeatable process for content strategy

You can show at least 2 examples of accounts you helped grow and monetize

You understand the difference between content for audience growth, authority/trust, and sales

You know how to support a business with multiple offers and live launches

You are comfortable switching between strategy and execution

You can collaborate well with a founder who already understands content strategy

You communicate clearly and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable with deadlines, structure, and accountability

This Is Not the Right Role If…



Please do not apply if any of the following are true:



You are still learning social media strategy and building your process as you go

Your experience is mostly engagement, posting support, or content coordination without measurable strategy results

You cannot clearly explain how your content strategy has supported sales or conversions

You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown

You only want to strategize and do not want to touch execution

You need to fully own every creative decision in order to do your best work

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or organized systems



How to Apply



To be considered, your application must include the following:



1) A brief breakdown of your content strategy framework



We want to understand how you think and how you work.



Please include:



how you approach a new brand from day one

title: Customer Service Representative (Airbnb / Short-Term Rentals - Evening Shift, Remote)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Nomad Equity is a U.S.-based short-term rental management company managing 49 vacation rental homes across California, Texas, Hawaii, Oregon, and beyond. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional guest experience while operating high-quality properties for our homeowners.



We're hiring a Customer Service Representative to join our remote team. This role goes beyond guest messaging: you'll also handle urgent maintenance and supply issues as they come up, and keep open maintenance tasks moving forward until they're done.



If you like being the person who actually gets things FIXED - not just the person who answers messages - this job was written for you.



WORK SCHEDULE



THIS IS AN EVENING / OVERNIGHT SHIFT covering U.S. Pacific Time.



You will work one of the following shifts (assigned based on coverage needs and your preference):

- Monday - Friday, 5:00 PM - 1:00 AM PST, or

- Monday - Friday, 1:00 AM - 9:00 AM PST



For applicants in the Philippines, these correspond to roughly 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM or 4:00 PM - 12:00 midnight Manila time.



If you cannot reliably commit to evening or overnight U.S. Pacific hours long-term, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Respond quickly to guests across our portfolio - pre-arrival questions, check-in help, and issues during the stay

- Handle urgent maintenance and supply escalations: coordinate the right vendor or handyman, keep the guest informed, and follow through until the issue is confirmed resolved

- Keep open maintenance tasks moving forward - chase vendors, update statuses, and escalate anything that's blocked

- Respond quickly to vendors and cleaners and coordinate with them via WhatsApp

- Post an end-of-shift summary and hand off cleanly to your shift partner



REQUIREMENTS



- Minimum 1 year experience working with Airbnb, VRBO, or another short-term rental platform (REQUIRED)

- Excellent written and verbal English (non-negotiable)

- Ability to use project management tools like Monday.com, ClickUp, Asana, email, etc.

- Experience coordinating vendors, maintenance, or field work is a big plus

- Strong follow-through - you close loops without being reminded

- Calm and professional under pressure, able to juggle multiple conversations at once

- Ability to reliably work an evening or overnight U.S. Pacific shift long-term (HARD REQUIREMENT)

- Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and a working phone for WhatsApp



COMPENSATION



- Rate: $5-$8 USD per hour, depending on experience

- Payment cadence: Biweekly, via Wise / Relay ACH

- 13th-month pay: Yes (paid in December)

- Paid time off: Earned starting after 6-month tenure

- Performance reviews: Every 6 months with rate adjustment opportunity

- Long-term, stable position with a growing company and a real team



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please visit NomadEquity.com/Careers and select the Airbnb CSR role.



You'll fill out a short application and then complete a brief AI screening interview right in your browser (about 10-15 minutes -- you'll need a webcam, a microphone, and a quiet space). You can complete it at your own convenience.



Please apply only through our careers page. We do not accept applications, resumes, or inquiries via email, direct message, or other channels. This ensures every applicant is reviewed fairly through the same process.



We respond to qualified applicants within 3 business days. Good luck!

mbers.

title: Appointment Setter / SDR (Full-time | 100% Remote | Cold Calling | US Hours | Night Shift PH)
description:
We’re looking for a full-time Appointment Setter / SDR to book qualified appointments for our US-based residential solar company. You do NOT need prior solar experience – we will train you on everything you need to know. Your main job is to be confident and clear on the phone. This is a 100% remote, phone-based role from your home – no in-person visits and no searching for your own leads. You’ll be calling leads we provide, following a clear script, and booking interested homeowners into our calendar.



This is a LONG-TERM role for someone who wants stable work, clear expectations, and honest pay. We want someone who plans to stay with us for years, not months.



ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

- Make high-volume phone calls (cold & warm) to leads we provide (100+ calls per day from home)

- Follow a simple script to confirm interest and book appointments

- Ask a few basic questions to confirm they’re a good fit for our solar programs

- Confirm best time and book appointments into our online calendar

- Accurately log calls and outcomes in our CRM (training provided)

- Hit daily & weekly call and appointment targets (we track calls, conversations, and appointments booked)



RESULT YOU OWN

Your main result: book qualified appointments with homeowners who are genuinely open to reviewing solar options to lower the electric bill for their home.



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong, clear, easy-to-understand spoken English

- Comfortable making 100+ phone calls per day and being on the phone most of your shift

- Stable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

- Able to work US Eastern hours (night shift PH time)

- Coachable and open to feedback

- Previous appointment setting / cold calling / call center experience is a PLUS but NOT REQUIRED as long as you sound great and have a positive attitude.

- No solar experience needed – we will train you on the product and process.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time: ~40 hours/week

- Monday to Friday, US Eastern hours (night shift in PH, roughly 9:00pm–5:00am PH time)



COMPENSATION (USD EQUIVALENT)

- Starting range (USD equivalent): $3.50–$4.00 USD per hour, depending on experience and how you sound on the phone during the interview.

- Your actual hourly rate will be agreed in PHP within this range and paid weekly via Wise/PayPal.

- After consistent good performance for 2 straight months, your hourly rate will be reviewed for a raise (towards the $4.00+ range).

- Strong performers can grow to the equivalent of $4.50–$5.25+ per hour over time.



This is an hourly role with performance-based raises, not a commission-only job. You get paid during training. You must have your own computer, headset, and reliable internet connection.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through this job post and include ALL of the following in your message:



1. 3–5 sentences on why you think you’d be a good fit for this job.

2. Confirm you can work US Eastern hours, Monday–Friday (night shift in PH).



Applications that do not include these two items may not be reviewed.



Shortlisted applicants will first join a brief group Zoom interview where we’ll listen to how you speak, have you read a short script, and answer your questions.
